Issue.Summary: ReportMagic export drops the instance filter when two datapoints are supplied
Issue.Description:
h2. Background
The ReportMagic export ignores the instance filter whenever two or more datapoint specs are supplied. Report authors then see every instance, which is wrong and hides the data they asked for. The change is in the export code path and the documentation for it needs updating.

h2. Proposed change
Apply the instance filter once per datapoint spec instead of once per export. Update the ReportMagic documentation page for the export macro to say so.
h2. Acceptance criteria
* The export must return only the filtered instances when two datapoint specs are supplied.
* Verify that a single spec still returns the same rows as before.
* Expected result: the report shows only the requested instances.

the roll stops on the first node that does not recover within five minutes.
